name: Sentinel-2 chlorophyll index time series over a named site
description: Compute per-scene mean NDCI, a chlorophyll-a proxy, over Sentinel-2 pixels classified as water at a named site inside Google Earth Engine. Only small per-scene summaries are returned; no imagery is downloaded.
planner_guidance: Use chlorophyll_timeseries to see whether a satellite chlorophyll proxy varies over a date window at a named site, for example around bloom dates reported in returned literature.
Choose an inclusive window of at most 366 days on or after 2017-03-28. Only the first 20 scenes in date order with at most 60 percent cloud are summarized; narrow the window to see a later period.
NDCI is a biomass proxy. It does not identify a species, confirm a bloom, or measure chlorophyll concentration.

arguments.name: site
arguments.description: A named study site. Each site is a fixed approximate bounding box recorded in the result.

arguments.name: start
arguments.description: First date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

arguments.name: end
arguments.description: Last date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

sources: Copernicus Sentinel-2 surface reflectance, Earth Engine collection COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED

limitations: NDCI (B5 - B4) / (B5 + B4) is a chlorophyll proxy; it does not identify a species or confirm a bloom.
Water pixels come from the Sentinel-2 scene classification and can include mixed shoreline, shallow bottom or residual cloud pixels.
The site is an approximate bounding box, and a 20 m scale averages over narrow channels.
Clouds, sun glint, tides and revisit gaps leave dates without usable scenes; a missing scene is not a negative observation.
No atmospheric or in-water validation against field measurements is performed.

policy_constraints.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed in Google Earth Engine. Earth Engine use requires a registered Cloud project and is subject to Earth Engine terms.
